items.summary: Recommendation: drain existing execution, repair, and measurement backlog; create no new implementation this cycle. Evidence: 174 approved proposals lack execution, 46 failed-request follow-ups remain open, 24 deployed improvements await measurement, and the action mandate lists no eligible candidate. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission, all unattributed to sites. Unknown: ROI, contribution margin, and causal lift. Continue existing work and approve only the prepared SearchWoot permission request.
